parsed.note_claim: No nationwide Discord ban exists in the Philippines; some telcos blocked access after CICC ordered local offices and child safety plans, others did not, and Discord is complying.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Globe and DITO were still blocking Discord at the CICC's afternoon briefing, and no network has said since that it has lifted the block. Smart and Converge never applied it.
parsed.reason: The page confirms that some carriers blocked Discord while others never did, and that Discord committed to a local presence, while the CICC lifted the ban.
